children: Subgen AI agreed to transfer three subsidiaries to Substrate AI for EUR 40.5M, settled with shares, debt offsets and convertible bonds. The transaction requires shareholder approval expected on 4 December 2026; it would reduce intercompany debt by approximately EUR 25.3M.
Consolidates the group's AI operations under Substrate AI; the release says operations will remain unchanged.
Subgen AI ownership rises to ~48.9% of shares
Voting rights would rise to ~62.3%, giving Subgen AI majority voting control of Substrate AI after completion.
Reduces debt within the group, though the release says consolidated accounts are not expected to be affected.
EUR 10.2M in mandatory convertible bonds issued
Eight-year bonds carry 7% annual capitalised interest and cannot be redeemed in cash, with conversion affecting future ownership.
Completion remains conditional on an extraordinary general meeting and other customary conditions.

This is an announced internal restructuring, with completion still subject to shareholder approval and other conditions. The next catalyst is the expected 4 December 2026 extraordinary general meeting, followed by closing within 15 business days after conditions are met or waived.
Based on the original press release from Subgen AI AB distributed by MFN by Modular Finance.
